findings.summary: Missing test coverage for CexFlowProxy payload in identity.test.ts.
findings.suggested_fix: Add test cases for CexFlowProxyPayloadV1 to verify its stable identity logic behaves correctly.

findings.summary: Unsafe type cast and missing exhaustive fallback in deriveOnChainFlowSourceObservationKey can cause runtime crashes on unknown event types.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the unsafe cast `const cexPayload = payload as CexFlowProxyPayloadV1;` with an explicit `if (payload.eventType === "cex_flow_proxy")` check, and add an exhaustive type check or error throw at the end of the function for unknown types.

findings.summary: Duplicated confidence computation logic between CEX and non-CEX branches.
findings.suggested_fix: Refactor enrichOnChainFlow to compute dataCompleteness and confidence unconditionally, adjusting sourceReliability beforehand and applying the CEX cap afterward.

findings.summary: mapEventTypeToKind parameter uses generic string instead of strict payload eventType union.
findings.suggested_fix: Change the type of the eventType parameter from `string` to `OnChainFlowPayloadV1["eventType"]` to enforce strict typing.
